crossRefs.note: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all…
For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good…
For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve…
to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with…
Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ…
Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown…
The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession…
For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will…
that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship…

translations.web: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
translations.bsb: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings.
translations.kjv: And this I do for ➔ the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker ➔ thereof with you.
translations.asv: And I do all things for the gospel's sake, that I may be a joint partaker thereof.
